section_1_generation_gate.artifact: snapshot_ladder/ladder.json tail-4, matched snapshot count (12 each), at run END
section_1_generation_gate.rule: NON_INFERIOR iff delta >= -15.0 AND CI95-low > -40.0; INFERIOR iff the whole CI < -15

bootstrap_crosscheck.note: parametric over games, refit per draw, no Hessian

section_1_generation_gate.se_method: PAIRED refit: full inverse-Hessian covariance, contrast c'Sigma c with c=1/4 on each run's tail-4. The NAIVE diagonal-only SE (5.20 post-tiebreak) understates by ~40% because tail nodes are jointly fit against shared anchors.
section_1_generation_gate.artifact_disagreement: Reported per runbook section 0. main.elo's SPARSE fit -- which is what main.endofrun's step_elo actually calls -- read delta -14.1, CI [-53.3, +25.1], INCONCLUSIVE. The dense ladder.json is the designated headline; the sparse fit is ORIENTATION and never the verdict. Reading endofrun's section-1 line as the verdict would have passed this generation.
section_1_generation_gate.caveat: Predicted SE 4.88, measured 8.54. Only the frozen-pair component scales with games; the bot/sentinel edges and the fit's prior do not. 4x games bought 12% SE, not 50% -- the verdict flipped on the POINT ESTIMATE moving (-29.98 -> -38.30), not on precision.
